Name: Luny's Hair Salon for FS
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
Been sitting on this for a while, but I finally made some images for it meaning I can finally post it! ⸜( ´ ꒳ ` )⸝

This is a simple mod that adds a few new hairstyles to Fashion Sense. I'm hoping to add more over time. I already have a short hairstyle almost finished, but it needs some more adjustments first.


To install:
Unzip the file and drop the contents into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. Only works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!


If you'd like to see updates on my projects, check out [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]my page on Kofi[/url]! You can also buy me a coffee if you like, but don't feel obligated!
